description: Configure cities, trade filters, minimum valuation, and date range to extract structured building permit records from official Socrata open-data portals.

cities.description: Select which official municipal open-data portals to query.
cities.title: Target Cities

customKeyword.description: Optional keyword to match inside the work description (e.g. 'EV CHARGER', 'SIDING', 'FOUNDATION'). Case-insensitive.
customKeyword.title: Custom Keyword Search (Optional)

daysBack.description: Fetch permits issued within the last N days.
daysBack.title: Lookback Period (Days)

maxItemsPerCity.description: Maximum number of matching permit records to extract per selected city.
maxItemsPerCity.title: Max Permits Per City

minValuationUsd.description: Only return permits with an estimated valuation equal to or greater than this amount (0 includes permits with unlisted cost).
minValuationUsd.title: Minimum Estimated Project Cost (USD)

tradeFilter.description: Filter permits by specific construction trade keywords, or choose 'all' for every permit type.
tradeFilter.title: Trade / Project Category Filter

title: US Municipal Building Permits Input
